NORTHAIRE COMFORT SYSTEMS CORPORATION
TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF SALE – EQUIPMENT AND/OR SERVICE

Rev. 12/10/24

1. PAYMENT AND TAXES - Invoices are payable within thirty (30) days of the invoice date. Northaire reserves the right to require cash in advance or to specify alternative payment arrangements prior to shipment or service completion if Northaire determines in its sole discretion that Customer's or Customer's assignee's financial standing does not support continuation of the thirty (30) day payment term. Customer shall remit all applicable taxes, duties, and government-imposed charges on transactions under this Agreement. If Customer claims exemption from such taxes or charges, Customer shall furnish Northaire with valid tax exemption documentation or applicable certificates. Any invoice not paid when due shall bear interest at the lesser of one percent (1%) per month or the maximum rate permitted by applicable law.

2. EXTRAS - Additional equipment, parts, or labor beyond the scope specified herein shall be provided only upon Customer's written authorization and shall be charged at Northaire's current labor rates and equipment/parts pricing. All such extras shall remain subject to this Agreement.

3. RETURNS - No merchandise shall be accepted for return without Northaire's prior written authorization. Returned items may be subject to a restocking fee. Items that are custom-ordered or non-stock are not returnable.

4. SHIPMENT - All shipments are on an EXW basis at Northaire's facility loading dock, which constitutes the shipping point. Customer assumes all responsibility for freight charges, customs procedures, and all risk of loss from the shipping point to the destination. Delivery dates quoted are estimates only. Northaire does not warrant specific shipment or delivery dates.

5. PARTIAL SHIPMENT - Northaire may elect to ship equipment, materials, or goods in portions and to invoice Customer for each partial shipment.

6. DELAYS - Northaire shall not be held liable for delays in manufacturing, shipment, or delivery caused by circumstances beyond Northaire's reasonable control and without Northaire's fault or negligence, including but not limited to: acts of God, acts of war, government actions, acts of terrorism, fires, floods, disease outbreaks, quarantine restrictions, freight embargoes, supplier delays, work stoppages, or labor disputes (collectively "Force Majeure Events"). Performance obligations are suspended to the extent that such Force Majeure Events continue to impair Northaire's ability to perform, regardless of whether the triggering event has concluded. Northaire shall notify Customer in writing of delays and their causes as soon as practicable. Should any equipment or materials become permanently unobtainable due to a Force Majeure Event, Northaire shall be relieved of its obligation to supply such items.

7. WARRANTY - Northaire warrants that all equipment manufactured by Northaire and all parts or components supplied will be free from defects in materials and workmanship. At Northaire's option, defective equipment, parts, or components shall be repaired or replaced on an EXW basis at the point of sale, provided such defects are discovered within one (1) year from the date of first operation or eighteen (18) months from the shipment date, whichever occurs first. For products not manufactured by Northaire, Northaire passes through any transferable manufacturer warranties. Service work is warranted to be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner. If service is found to be defective within ninety (90) days of completion, Northaire shall either re-perform the service or issue a service credit, at its option. Northaire's obligation to repair or replace defective items during the warranty period constitutes the exclusive remedy. Northaire shall not pay for labor to remove or reinstall defective items, transportation charges, handling fees, refrigerant or other operating fluid losses, or repairs resulting from faulty installation, misapplication, vandalism, abuse, chemical exposure, improper servicing, unauthorized modification, or improper use by persons other than Northaire personnel. THIS WARRANTY IS PROVIDED IN LIEU OF ALL OTHER WARRANTIES, WHETHER EXPRESS, IMPLIED, OR STATUTORY, INCLUDING ALL IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE. CUSTOMER ACKNOWLEDGES THAT NORTHAIRE MAKES NO REPRESENTATION OR WARRANTY THAT IRON, STEEL, MANUFACTURED PRODUCTS, OR CONSTRUCTION MATERIALS USED IN WARRANTY REPAIR OR REPLACEMENT WILL COMPLY WITH THE INFRASTRUCTURE INVESTMENT AND JOBS ACT, THE BUY AMERICAN ACT, OR COMPARABLE STATUTES OR REGULATIONS.

8. WORKING HOURS - All services, including major repairs, shall be performed during Northaire's standard business hours unless the parties agree otherwise in writing.

9. CUSTOMER RESPONSIBILITIES (Service Contracts Only) - Customer shall:

• Provide safe and unobstructed access to equipment and maintain a safe work environment.
• Grant Northaire access to Customer's premises and building infrastructure including water, freight elevators, loading areas, electrical systems, and telephone connections.
• Maintain areas surrounding equipment free from clutter; relocate inventory, fixtures, or structures as necessary for service work.
• Notify Northaire promptly of any unusual operational conditions or performance issues.
• Permit Northaire to operate and restart equipment as reasonably needed to perform service work upon mutual scheduling.
• Maintain proper water treatment systems.
• Operate equipment in accordance with Northaire's instructions and manufacturer guidance.
• Maintain routine equipment operation logs and readings if not covered by this Agreement.
• If Northaire provides remote monitoring, supply and maintain all necessary communications infrastructure including telephone capability with long distance and answer capabilities, internet connectivity, or Wi-Fi service.
• Address any mold, fungal, mildew, or bacterial issues promptly.
• Secure the work area against unauthorized access.
• Identify and mark any asbestos-containing materials on the premises. For buildings or equipment predating 1982, Customer shall provide Northaire a signed written statement confirming the presence or absence of asbestos and the method used to determine such absence.

10. EXCLUSIONS - Northaire shall not be responsible for maintenance or repair of items that are not mechanical equipment systems, including but not limited to: ductwork, casings, enclosures, cabinets, fixtures, structural framing, support structures, water lines, steam lines, drain lines, cooling tower media, boiler components, or electrical disconnects and breakers. Northaire shall not be responsible for repairs, replacements, modifications, supplemental work, unscheduled or emergency calls, or damage resulting from negligent operation, misuse, abuse, inadequate prior maintenance, vandalism, obsolescence, building system design, extreme weather conditions, chemical or electrochemical deterioration, corrosion, erosion, abnormal wear and tear, mold or biological contamination, electrical power disruptions or failures, or other causes outside Northaire's reasonable control. Northaire shall not be obligated to perform inspections or testing, install equipment or systems, or execute modifications recommended or mandated by insurers or governmental authorities. Should such recommendations be issued, Northaire may, at its discretion, submit a separate proposal to Customer. Northaire shall not repair or replace equipment that has not been adequately maintained.

11. EQUIPMENT CONDITION & RECOMMENDED SERVICE (Service Contracts Only) - Upon initial start-up and annual system inspections, Northaire shall provide Customer with a written condition report identifying any repairs or replacements needed along with pricing for such work beyond this Agreement. If Customer elects not to authorize and timely implement recommended services, Northaire shall have no responsibility for equipment or control failures, operational issues, or resulting damage. Northaire may choose to continue service on a best-effort no-warranty basis or may elect to exclude such equipment from this Agreement and adjust fees accordingly.

12. PROPRIETARY RIGHTS - Northaire may install, attach to Customer's equipment, or provide mobile devices (hardware and/or software) that shall remain Northaire's exclusive proprietary property. Such devices shall not become part of Customer's real property or fixtures. Customer shall acquire no ownership interest, title, equity, or rights in any hardware, software, processes, or intellectual property associated with service equipment.

13. DATA RIGHTS - Customer hereby grants Northaire a worldwide, non-exclusive, non-terminable, irrevocable, perpetual, fully paid, royalty-free license to any Source Data, including the right to sublicense to Northaire's affiliates and service providers for: (i) performing services under this Agreement; (ii) enhancement of Northaire's service offerings and Analytics Platform; (iii) improving product performance, operation, reliability, and service; (iv) creating and analyzing datasets and statistical compilations for benchmarking, best practice development, and product enhancement; (v) providing services to other parties; (vi) research, statistical analysis, and marketing; and (vii) supporting Northaire's other commercial arrangements.

Source Data shall mean information generated directly from any system or device and received at a data collection point or central server, including any Northaire database, data repository, or third-party cloud infrastructure.

Analytics Platform shall mean computational systems or web-based interfaces that interpret, process, calculate, analyze, or deliver data to Northaire, its affiliates, service providers, or Customer.

14. RETURN OF DATA - Customer understands that portable devices will collect Source Data that is transmitted to Northaire's systems and to Northaire's service providers, who process and store such data for service delivery purposes. Once such data is stored or transmitted to Northaire's infrastructure, it becomes part of Northaire's proprietary database and is governed by the license terms in Section 13.

15. DATA DELIVERY - During the Agreement term, Customer shall: (i) exercise reasonable efforts to maintain continuous power to hardware devices; (ii) refrain from intentional actions to obstruct, interrupt, or throttle data collection and transmission; and (iii) refrain from disabling, powering down, or removing hardware without Northaire's express written permission, which shall not be unreasonably withheld.

16. REVERSE ENGINEERING - Customer shall not extract, decompile, disassemble, or reverse engineer any software included with or incorporated in the hardware and shall not reverse engineer any reports, analytics, or data products provided by Northaire.

17. WAIVER OF DAMAGES - Under no circumstances shall Northaire be liable for indirect, incidental, collateral, special, exemplary, punitive, or consequential damages, including but not limited to lost revenue or profit, product recalls, loss of use or availability of equipment, data loss, or economic harm arising from any cause whatsoever.

18. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY - Except for claims arising from personal injury, Northaire's total liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the aggregate amounts actually paid by Customer to Northaire.

19. CANCELLATION - Customer may cancel this Agreement only with Northaire's prior written consent and upon payment of reasonable cancellation charges, which shall include all direct and indirect costs incurred by Northaire, purchase commitments and obligations made on Customer's behalf, and a reasonable profit allocation for work in progress.

20. CUSTOMER TERMINATION FOR NORTHAIRE NON-PERFORMANCE - Customer may terminate if Northaire fails to cure non-performance within thirty (30) days after receiving written notice. Upon early termination or expiration, Northaire shall have unrestricted access to Customer's premises to remove its proprietary equipment, devices, parts, tools, and property. Customer shall pay Northaire for all accrued but unamortized service costs, including overhead allocations and a reasonable profit margin.

21. NORTHAIRE TERMINATION - Northaire may discontinue service if Customer fails to make payments when due or if third parties make unauthorized alterations, additions, or repairs to the equipment during the Agreement term without Northaire's prior written approval.

22. CLAIMS - Any lawsuit arising from this Agreement, whether based on contract, negligence, strict liability, or other legal theory, must be commenced within one (1) year from the date the claim arose, except that claims for non-payment are excluded from this limitation. In any dispute, Northaire shall be entitled to recover all reasonable costs and expenses of enforcing its rights, including all attorney's fees, expert witness fees, and other litigation costs.

23. GOVERNMENT PROCUREMENTS - The equipment and services provided are commercial products and services as defined in the Federal Acquisition Regulations ("FAR"), based on Northaire's standard commercial pricing and practices. Northaire will not provide cost or pricing certifications or comply with Cost Accounting Standards. Federal procurement regulations including FAR or DFARS shall not apply except those specifically accepted in writing by Northaire.

24. INTERNATIONAL TRADE COMPLIANCE - Products sold to Customer are subject to export control and trade regulations of applicable jurisdictions including the European Union, United States, and United Kingdom.

a. Customer shall conduct all activities in compliance with applicable Trade Control Laws.

b. Customer shall not sell, supply, export, reexport, or transfer Products to: (1) Belarus, Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Russia, Syria, or the Crimea, Donetsk, Kherson, Luhansk, or Zaporizhzhia regions of Ukraine, or any other region designated as restricted; (2) individuals or entities designated on the U.S. Department of Treasury OFAC Specially Designated Nationals List, U.S. Commerce Department Entity List, European Union Consolidated Sanctions List, or UK Consolidated Sanctions List; (3) governments of restricted countries, Venezuela, or Afghanistan; (4) residents or entities organized in restricted countries; (5) entities owned or controlled by sanctioned parties; or (6) persons acting on behalf of sanctioned parties; (3) for unauthorized end-uses; or (4) in violation of Trade Control Laws.

c. Customer shall exercise reasonable diligence to verify customer and end-user identity, location, and product end-use. Customer shall promptly notify Northaire of any transactions involving restricted countries, sanctioned parties, or other Trade Control Law violations.

d. Northaire will not provide warranty, repair, replacement, or service for Products shipped to restricted territories or sanctioned parties or in violation of Trade Control Laws. If Customer provides broader warranties to its customers, Customer assumes all costs and liability.

e. Upon request, Customer shall promptly disclose all Product export information including description, quantity, value, parties, dates, and service details.

f. Customer represents that neither it nor its officers, employees, or affiliates are sanctioned parties or located in restricted countries.

g. Northaire may immediately terminate if: (1) Customer becomes a sanctioned party; (2) Customer violates Trade Control Laws; or (3) Northaire determines that legal compliance prohibits its performance. Termination constitutes termination for cause, relieving Northaire of all sales and service obligations.

h. Customer shall indemnify and hold Northaire harmless from all liabilities and costs arising from Trade Control Law violations, to the extent permitted by law. Northaire shall not be liable for penalties, fines, or consequential damages imposed on Customer.

25. HAZARDOUS MATERIALS - Customer is solely responsible for identifying, detecting, remedying, encapsulating, and removing asbestos, asbestos-containing materials, other hazardous substances, and mold, fungal, or bacterial contamination at the work site. If Northaire encounters such materials, Northaire may immediately suspend work and evacuate personnel until remediation is completed to Northaire's satisfaction. Performance schedules shall be extended accordingly, and Northaire shall be compensated for such delays.

26. WASTE DISPOSAL - Customer shall be entirely responsible for removal and lawful disposal of waste oil, refrigerant, and all other waste generated during the Agreement term.

27. SUPERSEDURE, ASSIGNMENT and MODIFICATION - This Agreement is the complete and exclusive understanding between the parties and supersedes all prior negotiations, understandings, and agreements. Customer may not assign without Northaire's written consent; however, Northaire may assign upon written notice. Modifications require written agreement signed by both parties. Customer's orders become binding upon Northaire's written acceptance by an authorized representative. NORTHAIRE'S ACCEPTANCE OF CUSTOMER'S ORDER IS EXPRESSLY CONDITIONED ON CUSTOMER'S ACCEPTANCE AND COMPLIANCE WITH THESE TERMS. THIS AGREEMENT CONSTITUTES THE ENTIRE UNDERSTANDING AND MAY NOT BE MODIFIED WITHOUT WRITTEN SIGNATURE OF A NORTHAIRE OFFICER OR AUTHORIZED REPRESENTATIVE. NORTHAIRE'S FAILURE TO OBJECT TO CUSTOMER'S PURCHASE ORDER TERMS DOES NOT CONSTITUTE ACCEPTANCE OF THOSE TERMS OR WAIVER OF NORTHAIRE'S TERMS. ANY CONFLICTING OR SUPPLEMENTARY PROVISIONS IN CUSTOMER'S DOCUMENTS ARE NOT BINDING ON NORTHAIRE, AND NORTHAIRE EXPRESSLY OBJECTS THERETO.

28. CUSTOMER CONSENT - Customer grants Northaire and its successors and assigns the right to photograph and record video at Customer's premises where equipment is installed or service is performed. Customer consents to Northaire's use of such images, recordings, Customer's name, and the nature of Customer's relationship with Northaire in all media formats for promotional purposes including press releases, case studies, social media, newsletters, and marketing materials.

29. FOR WORK BEING PERFORMED IN CALIFORNIA - Contractors performing work in California are subject to licensing and regulation by the Contractors' State License Board. Complaints regarding latent defects may be filed within four (4) years of the alleged violation; complaints regarding structural defects may be filed within ten (10) years. Information regarding contractors may be obtained from the Registrar, Contractors' State License Board, P.O. Box 26000, Sacramento, California 95826.

30. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY - Northaire retains all right, title, and interest in its intellectual property. No license is granted except as necessary to allow Customer to use deliverables and services provided under this Agreement.

31. DATA PRIVACY - Northaire processes personal information in accordance with applicable data privacy law including the California Consumer Privacy Act and European General Data Protection Regulation. Each party shall comply with applicable privacy laws and implement reasonable safeguards for personal data. Customer represents it has legal authority to provide any personal information to Northaire and shall obtain necessary consents and provide required notices. If Customer provides personal information from California residents, that party is a "Service Provider" under CCPA and shall not sell such data.

32. FACTORY ACCEPTANCE TESTS AND INSPECTIONS - Any factory acceptance testing or inspections shall be limited to matters directly related to Agreement performance. Tests shall require mutual agreement, comply with Northaire policy and approval procedures, comply with Customer policy and all applicable laws, and comply with anti-corruption requirements.

33. CHANGE ORDER / ADDITIONAL WORK / PRICE ADJUSTMENTS - Northaire shall not perform additional work until receiving a written change order signed by both parties specifying scope, price, and any schedule adjustments. Additional work shall remain subject to this Agreement's terms. The prices of services performed and/or equipment purchased under this Agreement are subject to change due to increases in material costs related to tariffs, import duties, trade policy, epidemics, commodity or material costs, fuel surcharges, supplier costs, labor costs, or related impacts or market conditions. Such change shall come into effect on thirty (30) days' prior written notice from Northaire to Customer. Equipment pricing is subject to escalation based on the Producer Price Index (PPI) published by the U.S. Department of Labor Bureau of Labor Statistics for commodity PCU33341-33341 HVAC and Commercial Refrigeration Equipment. Escalation shall be calculated as: (i) total Agreement price multiplied by (ii) PPI at equipment delivery date divided by (iii) PPI at Agreement execution date. Total Agreement price shall not be subject to reduction.

34. OCCUPATIONAL SAFETY AND HEALTH (Service Contracts Only) - The parties shall immediately notify each other of any OSHA inspection, investigation, or alleged violation related to the Agreement, project, or work site.

35. ANTI-DISCRIMINATION POLICY - Northaire's workplace respect and safety policy is incorporated herein by reference.

36. EQUIPMENT RENTALS - If this Agreement includes equipment rental, Northaire's Rental Systems Master Terms and Conditions shall apply to rental equipment.

37. STATE CONTRACTOR LICENSE NUMBERS - Northaire's state contractor licenses, certificates, and registrations are listed on Northaire's website and are incorporated herein.

38. ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS - If this Agreement includes equipment or services related to a specific Northaire product platform or subscription service, the additional terms specific to that platform shall apply and are incorporated herein.

39. ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS - If this Agreement includes a subscription to Northaire's Abound platform, the Abound Master SaaS Subscription Agreement shall apply and is incorporated herein.

40. ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS - If this Agreement includes a subscription to Northaire's i-Vu Cloud platform, the i-Vu Master SaaS Subscription Agreement shall apply and is incorporated herein.
